description: Use this when the user wants to practice reading supplied text one word at a time. Accepts up to 20,000 characters, 100 to 1,000 words per minute, and 1 to 4 words per flash. Returns the word count and scheduled reading time; it is a training aid and does not measure comprehension.

text.description: Text to pace in the reader, up to 20,000 characters, e.g. The harbor lights returned after the rain.

words_per_flash.description: Words shown together on each flash from 1 to 4, e.g. 1.

words_per_minute.description: Pacing speed from 100 to 1,000 words per minute, e.g. 350.

name: show_speed_reader
title: Show speed reader
